channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Man shot by ICE agent in NYC's Marble Hill, officials say
item.description: A man was hospitalized after being shot by an ICE agent in New York City's Marble Hill neighborhood, according to DHS and city officials.

item.title: Fugitive allegedly lived double life as chef
item.description: U.S. Marshals say a man known as Troy Williams, a chef at Miss B's Coconut Club in San Diego, is actually 50-year-old Brian Anthony Williams.

item.title: Nobel Peace Prize goes to former ICC judge Navanethem Pillay
item.description: The 2026 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, a former International Criminal Court judge sanctioned by the Trump administration.

item.title: Texas landowners push back against Trump's border wall
item.description: The Trump administration is advancing a $46 billion border wall stretching from the Pacific Ocean to the Gulf of Mexico.
